description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

description.zh: 结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end time. This value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in milliseconds.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
列表排序方式。取值：

- asc：正序。

- desc：倒序。
description.en:
The sort order of the list. Valid values:

- asc: ascending order.

- desc: descending order.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第1页数据。
description.en: The page number of the page to return in a paged query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page. For more information about paging, see the paging parameters.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**5**，表示每页包含5条结果。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **5**, which indicates 5 entries per page. For more information about paging, see the paging parameters.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh: 开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start time. This value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in milliseconds.

description.zh:
敏感数据类型。取值：

- request：请求敏感数据。

- response：响应敏感数据。
description.en:
The type of sensitive data. Valid values:

- request: request sensitive data.

- response: response sensitive data.

title.zh: 查询API安全敏感数据域名统计
title.en: Query API security sensitive data domain name statistics

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-sensitive-domain-statistic --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --cluster-id 428 --start-time 1668496310 --end-time 1686895256 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --type request --order-way desc --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeApisecSensitiveDomainStatistic --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --Type request --EndTime 1686895256 --PageSize 10 --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --ClusterId 428 --PageNumber 1 --StartTime 1668496310 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --OrderWay desc
